description: Busiest/quietest-day stats (max, min, average, total) for TSA's daily airport checkpoint screening counts over a period — e.g. "busiest travel day of 2026" or "average daily screenings last July". Pass `year`, a `start_date`/`end_date` range, or nothing for the current year to date. Covers 2019-01-01 through roughly yesterday's date in 2026. Returns found:false (not an error) if the period has no published data yet. Keyless.
name: tsa_checkpoint_stats
